notes: Partition verified: 29 source and 33 target tokens each covered once.
*Forty years old was I* is a verbless age clause: the construct בֶּן carries *old* together with the construction-supplied copula, and אָנֹכִי keeps only *I* (rule 20).
The *it* of *as it was in my heart* is given to דָּבָר as rule 25's resumed referent; the competing `added` impersonal-subject reading under rule 20 is named in that unit's note.
*brought ... again* keeps the particle with שׁוּב because the bare *brought* does not write the returning (rule 44); *spy out* keeps its particle on the same subtraction, headed on the verb.
All three object markers are `unrepresented` — *sent me*, *brought him word* — since the ASV writes the objects bare (rule 16).
